title: List of Huntik Foundation Missions
summary:
Huntik Foundation missions are assigned to Huntik Foundation teams by the Huntik Foundation Council. These missions involve uncovering more information regarding magic and Titans as well as preventing the Organization from achieving their nefarious goals. Many notable missions were assigned by Guggenheim or Metz to the team of Dante Vale, Sophie Casterwill, Lok Lambert, Zhalia Moon, and newcomer Den Fears. 

The following is a chronological list of officially named missions that were officially assigned to Dante's team by the Huntik Foundation and logged by the Holotome. Out of the 28 officially logged missions listed below, 22 were completed and 6 were unsuccessful, corresponding to a success rate of approximately 78.6%.
